label: Esse dependence entails its sustaining sibling (inference)
rule: Instantiate 2068f91c; the giving antecedent is unused
meaning: Strength order registration: 2068f91c (every distinct cause of x's esse is one x depends on for its being) entails its restriction to causes that give x being at every moment at which x is present, in every history. Application only; it establishes neither. Strictness is witnessed by Control part 1.
